stops.title: Ron wan Fɛloship
stops.caption: Yu grup, yu rɛjista.
stops.speech: If yu de lid wan fɛloship yu de manej in mɛmba dɛn, rɛkɔd ɛvri mitin, ɛn si udat dɔn kwayɛt stɔp fɔ kam.

stops.title: In Mitin dɛn
stops.caption: Wan rɔl kɔl pɛ mitin.
stops.speech: Ɛvri mitin gɛt in yon rɔl kɔl. Ɔva fyu wik dat de tɔn di atɛndans patan we di ripɔt dɛn de rid.
